authority.note: This is a commit-pinned gap-closure and execution design, not an acceptance prediction or claim ratification.
authority.programme_authorization_note: The matrix distinguishes scientific gaps from currently authorized execution. Returned, deferred, spent, and external-authority lanes are not reopened by this artifact.

review_board.decision_rule: No paper may be upgraded unless all four roles agree that the stronger claim is proved/tested, reproducible, and materially novel/significant. External authority remains external.
